notes: «قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا جرير» — two branches (Ishaq alone; the other two together) meet at جرير, which the text writes once: shared tail (rule 3)
«- واللفظ لزهير -» is an editor's gloss and is left out
The men who said «رجل» and the question in the scene are not links; Ali is the Companion who relays the saying
